overall_limitations: Several composite rubric entries are split across claims. Individual gold_ids credit only entries adequately stated by that claim; complementary claims are not duplicates.
The claims omit transaction-start end-mark fixation, WAL-index lookup acceleration and same-host restriction, the one-writer limit, and WAL-size read amplification.
Other omissions include NOOP's status-query purpose, reciprocal hook replacement, and multi-database error continuation versus abandonment.
The four skipped surrounding concepts are named but lack claims establishing their distinct mechanisms.
S1 and S2 differ on reader blocking and completion descriptions for aggressive checkpoints. The output appropriately follows S2 for specific API behavior.
